bands.name: Calm
bands.label: Calm · 0–6 mph
bands.note: Flags hang. Nothing in the forecast is touching the ball.

bands.name: Breezy
bands.label: Breezy · 6–11 mph
bands.note: Noticeable at the top of a punt, not much else.

bands.name: Blustery
bands.label: Blustery · 11–16 mph
bands.note: Deep balls start dying and the completion rate goes with them.

bands.name: Windy
bands.label: Windy · 16+ mph
bands.note: The passing game comes apart. This is the band that matters.
